name: better-auth
title: Better Auth
description: Better Auth server config, Drizzle schema, session service, React client, OAuth buttons, provider, and the API route handler.
docs: Better Auth with email/password and GitHub/Google OAuth. Set `APP_SECRET` (it derives `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`) or set `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` directly, and `BETTER_AUTH_BASE_URL` if it differs from the site URL. Add `AUTH_GITHUB_ID`/`AUTH_GITHUB_SECRET` and/or `AUTH_GOOGLE_ID`/`AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET` for OAuth. The handler mounts at `/api/better-auth`. Bones already has the `better_auth_*` tables in its schema, so run `pnpm db:push` and no schema file is added.
